title: Billing the TRICARE Prime Effective Month by Enrollment Reason
content:
In the first installment of a fee-bearing TRICARE Prime enrollment, the month containing the effective date is valued by the reason for the enrollment:

| Enrollment reason | The month containing the effective date |
|---|---|
| a transfer in from another region | is not billed |
| a qualifying life event | counts as a whole month at the monthly rate |
| otherwise (initial eligibility, open season) | counts at the monthly rate times the lesser of 30 and its days from the effective date through the last day of the coverage period of the installment charge beginning on the effective date, 30 where no such charge stands, over 30, rounded to the cent |

Days are counted including both the effective date and that last day.

## Worked values (hypothetical, monthly rate 32.51, effective date 11 April, initial eligibility)

| Installment charge beginning 11 April covers through | Days counted | Value of April |
|---|---|---|
| 30 April | 20 | 32.51 times 20 over 30: 21.67 |
| 30 June | 81, so 30 | 32.51 |
| no charge begins on 11 April | 30 | 32.51 |

On the same dates, a qualifying-life-event enrollment values April at 32.51 and a transfer-in enrollment bills nothing for April.
